crossRefs.note: King Solomon made two hundred bucklers of beaten gold; six hundred shekels of gold went to one buckler.
King Solomon made two hundred bucklers of beaten gold. Six hundred shekels of beaten gold went to one buckler.

translations.web: He had bronze shin armor on his legs, and a bronze javelin between his shoulders.
translations.bsb: and he had armor of bronze on his legs and a javelin of bronze slung between his shoulders.
translations.kjv: And he had greaves of brass upon his legs, and a target of brass between his shoulders.
translations.asv: And he had greaves of brass upon his legs, and a javelin of brass between his shoulders.
